subject: Namco Classic Challenge
object: all hits on the final Galaga stage
text: After a logic update the achievement no longer checks the Devil Kazuya unlock flag; it checks for getting all hits on the final Galaga stage.

evidence.quote: Added save protection. Now it does not check for the unlock flag, it checks for getting all hits on the final Galaga stage.

subject: Namco Classic Challenge
text: Older comments said unlimited continues were allowed, but after later logic edits players report the achievement no longer triggers with multiple continues and only unlocks when using one.

evidence.quote: [Server] RyCuLe edited this achievement's logic.
Huh, the comments said unlimited continues, but I still didn't get it
It seems like it doesn't trigger when using multiple continues anymore. I finally got it using only one.

subject: Galaga
text: Beating Galaga's first stage in under 18.5 seconds unlocks the double spaceship with twice the firepower; stage 1 is by far the hardest and the later stages are easy with double ships.

evidence.quote: Beat the first stage in under 18.5sec to unlock the double spaceship for twice the fire power
Stage 1 was easily the hardest. Once you get Stage 1 down and can get the second ship, the rest is honestly extremely easy

subject: Galaga
text: Stage 1 takes most of the effort: memorize the perfect positions from a video and repeat them, and restart if the stage took longer than 18.5 seconds; once you have two ships you keep them for the following stages.

evidence.quote: you need to remember the perfect position just like the video and do the same
if you have two ships, you will keep them for other levels

subject: Namco Classic Challenge
object: one continue in the entire run
text: Players confirm multiple continues stop the achievement from working; it can only be earned using at most one retry in the entire run, not one per stage (tested on RetroArch 1.22.2 with Beetle PSX HW).

evidence.quote: Can confirm using multiple continues makes the achievement not work.
I can confirm that it can only be achieved by using 1 retry in the entire RUN and not 1 per round.
(RetroArch 1.22.2 with the Beetle PSX HW core)

object: double ship earned by the 18.5 second stage 1

subject: Galaga
text: (Translated from Spanish) If possible, enable a repeater for the X button in your emulator so you do not have to keep pressing fire; memorizing all 8 stages took one player about 7 to 8 hours.

evidence.translation: try to enable a repeater for the X button in your emulator, believe me it helps a lot so you are not pressing the button many times to fire

evidence.quote: memorizar los 8 niveles me llevo aproximadamente 7 a 8 horas
evidence.translation: memorizing the 8 stages took me about 7 to 8 hours

subject: Galaga
text: Lock down stage 1 ship positions by memory to make the 18.5 second time, then pause between stages to refresh your memory of the next formation; the final stage can still produce many 39/40 near-misses.

evidence.quote: Master the first stage, really lock down the positions of the ship by memory. After you got that you can get 18.5s 1st Stage without much of a hassle. Once you do take pauses between each stage to have refreshed memory on what is ahead
until the last stage, which gave me a bunch of 39/40 attempts before I finally did it

subject: Galaga
object: mark ship entry points on the screen
text: Mark the two points where enemy ships enter from the top of the screen and study the tutorial video's ship movement patterns; the second-to-last stage, with fast ships from the corners, is the other difficult one.

evidence.quote: mark on your monitor the two points where the ships enter from the top, and watch the tutorial video that was posted above
the second-to-last part, the one with the ships coming from the corners, because they are very fast

subject: Namco Classic Challenge
text: The set creator changed the achievement's logic, so older tips saying you could continue more than once no longer apply; stage 1 remains the hardest part.

evidence.quote: there is clearly a message showing that the creator of the set changed the logic for the achievement...meaning the achievement did not originally work like it was intended (ie. you could continue more than once).
Stage 1 is still the hardest part of this achievement and all of the additional tips provided still apply

subject: Devil Kazuya
text: Devil Kazuya is not needed for any other achievement in the set.

evidence.quote: you literally don't need devil Kazuya for ANY other achievement in the entire game

subject: Galaga stage 8
text: Stage 8 contains enemies that must be hit twice, which caused repeated 39/40 failures; one successful run used its single extra chance on stage 8.

evidence.quote: Had 4 runs end at stage 8 with 39/40 (Those things you need to hit twice, all the exact same line..)
In my final run messed up once in stage 8 but used my next and final chance on the stage to do it.
